newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Nov wholesale volume fall 1.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Nov wholesale volume fall 1.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales fell 1.3 percent year-on-year in November and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 1.4 percent, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Wednesday in a statement.
The volume of retail sales rose 5.4 percent and the value excluding VAT of those sales rose 5.9 percent, SF said.
In January-November, the wholesale volume rose 2.0 percent and retail sales volume increased 4.2 percent year-on-year, SF said.
